name: flashcomplete
description: Local-first, ultra-fast inline code completion against a llama.cpp server you run yourself. Model-agnostic engine; Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends arrive in v1.0.

flashcomplete.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the llama.cpp server you started manually, e.g. `llama-server -m model.gguf --port 8012`.

flashcomplete.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key, only if the server was started with `--api-key`.

flashcomplete.autoTrigger.description: Show completions automatically while typing. When off, use the 'FlashComplete: Trigger Completion' command.

flashcomplete.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before an automatic completion request is sent.

flashcomplete.requestTimeoutMs.description: Client-side timeout for a completion request, in milliseconds.

flashcomplete.nPrefix.description: Lines before the cursor included in the completion context.

flashcomplete.nSuffix.description: Lines after the cursor included in the completion context.

flashcomplete.nPredict.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion.

flashcomplete.maxLineSuffix.description: Skip automatic completion when more than this many characters follow the cursor on the current line.

flashcomplete.maxCacheKeys.description: Capacity of the client-side completion cache.

flashcomplete.ringNChunks.description: Maximum number of context chunks kept in the ring buffer.

flashcomplete.ringScope.description: How many lines around the cursor are eligible for context chunk gathering.

flashcomplete.ringUpdateMs.description: Interval in milliseconds for draining queued context chunks (and warming the server cache when supported).

flashcomplete.tMaxPromptMs.description: Server-side hint: maximum prompt processing time in milliseconds (llama.cpp).

flashcomplete.tMaxPredictMs.description: Server-side hint: maximum prediction time in milliseconds (llama.cpp).
